recognize_zh: 皮膚上有多處色素沉著斑塊與一顆紫紅色結節性腫瘤；皮膚切片 H&E 為真皮內瀰漫的非典型淋巴球浸潤，免疫染色呈大片 T 細胞陽性並向表皮延伸，臨床加病理組合符合皮膚型成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤 (ATLL)，需以 HTLV-1 血清學確認。
features: Panel A (clinical photo): multiple hyperpigmented patches/plaques on the trunk with a central violaceous dome-shaped nodule
Panel B H&E (scanning power): dense dermal lymphoid infiltrate beneath the epidermis
Panel B IHC: diffuse strong staining of the dermal infiltrate with focal epidermal involvement (Pautrier-like clusters) for a T-cell marker (labels not legible)
Panel B IHC (right half): weaker/patchy staining with other markers showing loss or limited expression in the infiltrate
High-power cytology not shown; cellular atypia cannot be assessed at this magnification
describe_en: Clinical photograph shows multiple hyperpigmented patches and plaques on the skin with a central violaceous nodular tumor. Skin biopsy at scanning magnification demonstrates a dense dermal lymphoid infiltrate that is diffusely positive for a T-cell marker, with focal epidermotropic clusters, while additional immunostains (labels not legible in the figure) are only focally positive, suggesting antigen loss. Cytologic detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. In context, findings are consistent with cutaneous involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; confirmation requires HTLV-1 serology/proviral integration and CD4+/CD25+ phenotype.

ddx.vs: MF and cutaneous ATLL overlap histologically; ATLL is distinguished by HTLV-1 positivity, strong CD25 expression and often hypercalcemia or circulating flower cells.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD30+ anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: cALCL consists of sheets of large CD30+ (>75%) anaplastic cells presenting as solitary ulcerated nodules without widespread patches.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: Diagnosed only after excluding HTLV-1 infection and MF by clinical and serologic correlation.
